description: Expired item in #oldCache is promoted to #cache and returned as live data
productionImpact: An expired item is moved into the hot cache with its original expiry timestamp and served on all subsequent reads until the next rotation. Callers relying on TTL enforcement — such as auth token or rate-limit caches — receive values that should have been invalidated, with a staleness window that can last as long as the entire rotation interval.
